name: Even Wave Spam
description: Evens out wave spam clicks by enforcing a steady gap between inputs.

wave-only.name: Wave only
wave-only.description: Only smooth inputs while you are in the wave gamemode.

gap-ms.name: Gap between inputs (ms)
gap-ms.description: Minimum real time between any two press/release events. Lower = faster spam. 25 ms is about 20 CPS.

max-delay-ms.name: Max queue delay (ms)
max-delay-ms.description: If queued clicks would be delayed longer than this, the backlog is dropped. Stops spam continuing after you stop.
